download_osf_project: download an OSF project dataset to a local directory using the osfclient library
download_donders_dataset: download a Donders Institute dataset via WebDAV using wget with authentication
download_osf_with_progress: download files from an OSF storage with a tqdm progress bar and skip existing files
download_donders_with_overwrite: download a Donders dataset and overwrite an existing download by passing overwrite=True
review_download_functions: review the download_osf and download_donders functions for dataset download capabilities
